quote: Gemini 3.1 Pro is rolling out starting today to developers via the Gemini API, to enterprises via Vertex AI, and to consumers through the Gemini app and NotebookLM.
note: Released by Google DeepMind on February 19, 2026. Developer preview version initially released for validation before general availability.
